section.content: The utility model is applied to cell art, a kind of lithium ion battery is provided, the lithium ion battery includes providing the battery core of electric energy, accommodates the storage case of battery core, is covered on storage case and forms a pair of conductive pressing plate of positive pole and negative pole electric connection of metal cover board and battery core of confined space, the insulation spacer that is arranged between conductive pressing plate and metal cover board and between conductive pressing plate and metal cover board and both ends support the insulated support of conductive pressing plate and metal cover board respectively.The utility model between conductive pressing plate and metal cover board by being provided with insulated support, battery core is when occurring short-circuit a large amount of heat production, so that after insulation spacer melts, insulated support is supported between conductive pressing plate and metal cover board, prevent conductive pressing plate close to metal cover board, so as to avoid positive conductive pressing plate and negative conductive pressing plate while contacted with metal cover board, avoid battery large area short-circuit.

本实用新型适用于电池技术领域，提供了种锂离子电池，该锂离子电池包括提供电能的电芯、容纳电芯的容纳箱、盖设于容纳箱形成密闭空间的金属盖板、与电芯的正极和负极电性连接的对导电压板、设置于导电压板与金属盖板之间的绝缘垫片以及位于导电压板与金属盖板之间且两端分别抵持导电压板和金属盖板的绝缘支撑件。本实用新型通过在导电压板和金属盖板之间设置有绝缘支撑件，电芯在发生短路大量产热时，使得绝缘垫片融化后，绝缘支撑件抵持在导电压板和金属盖板之间，阻止导电压板向金属盖板靠近，从而可以避免正极导电压板和负极导电压板同时与金属盖板接触，避免电池大面积短路。

Lithium ion batteryTechnical field

The utility model belongs to cell art, more particularly to a kind of lithium ion battery.

Background technology

With the intensification that international energy shortage, the air pollution of getting worse and the mankind realize to low-carbon environment-friendly, " energy-conservation Environmental protection " has risen the strategic height as State-level.In automobile industry field, increasing Automobile Enterprises gather sight For Jiao in new-energy automobile, the bright prospects of new-energy automobile industry have promoted the fast development of lithium-ion-power cell industry.

Generally, lithium ion battery includes accommodating the storage case of battery core, the metal cover board covered on storage case and positioned at appearance Receive two conductive pressing plates being connected outside case and with battery core positive and negative electrode.Wherein, the effect of conductive pressing plate mainly facilitates external electricity Sub-device to it to be powered.Battery short circuit is caused in order to avoid the two conductive pressing plates contact with metal cover board simultaneously, one As be that insulation spacer is set at two between conductive pressing plate and metal cover board, but battery core is when occurring short-circuit a large amount of heat production, absolutely Edge pad can melt so that two conductive pressing plates contact simultaneously with metal cover board so that the direct Electricity Federation of both positive and negative polarity of battery, Expand short-circuit area, cause battery to generate heat rapidly, security incident easily occurs.

Utility model content

The purpose of this utility model is to provide a kind of lithium ion battery, it is intended to solves a large amount of heat production of battery in the prior art When, insulation spacer, which melts, causes two conductive pressing plates directly to be contacted with metal cover board, causes the direct Electricity Federation of both positive and negative polarity of battery, causes The technical problem of large area short circuit.

The utility model is achieved in that a kind of lithium ion battery, including for providing electric energy and there is positive pole and bear The battery core of pole, have opening and for accommodate the battery core storage case, be covered in the opening with the receiving box-shaped Into confined space and by metal cover board of the battery core envelope in the confined space, positioned at the metal cover board backwards to institute A pair of conductive pressing plate for stating the side of storage case and being electrically connected with respectively with the positive pole and negative pole of the battery core, be arranged at it is described Insulation spacer between conductive pressing plate and the metal cover board and between the conductive pressing plate and the metal cover board and Both ends support the insulated support of the conductive pressing plate and the metal cover board respectively, and the conductive pressing plate includes and the battery core The positive conductive pressing plate that is electrically connected with of positive pole and the negative conductive pressing plate that is connected with the negative pole of the battery core.

Further, the insulated support is made of ceramic material.

Further, the metal cover board is provided with perforate, and the lithium ion battery also includes one end positioned at described closed Space and be electrically connected with the electrode of the battery core and the other end extend to the metal cover board and with the metal cover board without The electrode column through the perforate of contact, the one end of the electrode column away from the storage case and the conductive pressing plate fixation with Electricity is streamed to the conductive pressing plate.

Further, the conductive pressing plate is provided with fixing hole, and the electrode column is included in the confined space Bottom plate and extend along the bottom plate to the metal cover board and with the metal cover board it is contactless pass through the perforate Conductive pole, the conductive pole inserts the fixing hole and is connected with the fixing hole interference.

Further, the insulated support is annular in shape and is sheathed on the conductive pole.

Further, the upper surface of the metal cover board is provided with the lower mounting groove for insulated support lower end insertion, The lower surface of the conductive pressing plate is provided with the upper mounting groove for insulated support upper end insertion.

Further, the insulation spacer is provided with spacing hole, and the metal cover board, which is provided with, inserts the spacing hole Spacing preiection.

Further, the conductive pressing plate is provided with boss towards the side of insulation spacer, and the insulation spacer is towards described The side of conductive pressing plate is provided with the storage tank for boss insertion.

Further, explosion-proof through hole is provided with the metal cover board, the metal cover board also includes envelope located at described anti- Burst disk of the quick-fried through hole close to the storage case side.

Further, the lithium ion battery includes envelope located at the explosion-proof through hole away from the explosion-proof of the storage case side Diaphragm.

The utility model has the technical effect that relative to prior art：Lithium ion battery provided by the utility model is in conduction Insulated support is provided between pressing plate and metal cover board, battery core is when occurring short-circuit a large amount of heat production so that insulation spacer melts Afterwards, insulated support is supported between conductive pressing plate and metal cover board, prevents conductive pressing plate close to metal cover board, so as to Avoid positive conductive pressing plate and negative conductive pressing plate while contacted with metal cover board, avoid the short circuit of battery large area.

Fig. 1 to Fig. 7 is referred to, the lithium ion battery that the utility model embodiment provides includes being used to provide electric energy and have The battery core 10 of positive pole and negative pole, there is opening 21 and for accommodating the storage case 20 of the battery core 10, being covered on the opening 21 On to form confined space 22 and metal by the envelope of battery core 10 in the confined space 22 with the storage case 20 Cover plate 30, positioned at side of the metal cover board 30 away from the storage case 20 and respectively with the positive pole of the battery core 10 and negative A pair of conductive pressing plate 40 of pole electric connection, the insulation spacer being arranged between the conductive pressing plate 40 and the metal cover board 30 50 and between the conductive pressing plate 40 and the metal cover board 30 and both ends support the conductive pressing plate 40 and institute respectively The insulated support 60 of metal cover board 30 is stated, the conductive pressing plate 40 includes the positive pole being electrically connected with the positive pole of the battery core 10 Conductive pressing plate 41 and the negative conductive pressing plate 42 being connected with the negative pole of the battery core 10.

Fig. 1 to Fig. 7 is referred to, the lithium ion battery that the utility model embodiment provides is in conductive pressing plate 40 and metal cover board Insulated support 60 is provided between 30, battery core 10 is when occurring short-circuit a large amount of heat production so that after insulation spacer 50 melts, insulation Support member 60 is supported between conductive pressing plate 40 and metal cover board 30, prevents conductive pressing plate 40 close to metal cover board 30, from And positive conductive pressing plate 41 and negative electricity pole 70 can be avoided while contacted with metal cover board 30, it is short to solve battery large area The problem of road.

Fig. 1 to Fig. 7 is referred to, further, the insulated support 60 is made of ceramic material.The utility model is real It is mainly to utilize ceramic (Al2O3) good heat resistance (up to more than 3000 DEG C), when avoiding 10 thermal runaway of battery core, positive pole to apply example Conductive pressing plate 41 and negative electricity pole 70 directly contact with metal cover board 30 simultaneously, cause large area short-circuit.

Fig. 1 to Fig. 7 is referred to, further, the metal cover board 30 is provided with perforate 31, and the lithium ion battery also wraps One end is included to be located at the confined space 22 and be electrically connected with the electrode of the battery core 10 and the other end is to the metal cover board 30 Extend and the electrode column 70 through the perforate 31 contactless with the metal cover board 30, the electrode column 70 are remote described One end of storage case 20 is fixed so that electricity is streamed into the conductive pressing plate 40 with the conductive pressing plate 40.It should be understood that institute State electrode column 70 and the metal cover board 30 is contactless, after mainly avoiding positive and negative electrode post 70 from being contacted with metal cover board 30, hair Raw short circuit, specifically, the internal diameter of perforate 31 should be more than the external diameter of electrode column 70, the inwall of perforate 31 and electrode column are ensured with this 70 is spaced at a certain distance.The other one end of electrode column 70 away from storage case 20 is fixed with conductive pressing plate 40, can be by electricity Conductive pressing plate 40 is streamed to, further transmits electric energy to electronic installation.

Fig. 7 is referred to, further, the conductive pressing plate 40 is provided with fixing hole 43, and the electrode column 70 includes being located at Bottom plate 71 in the confined space 22 and extend along the bottom plate 71 to the metal cover board 30 and with the metal The contactless conductive pole 72 through the perforate 31 of cover plate 30, the conductive pole 72 insert the fixing hole 43 and with it is described solid Determine the interference connection of hole 43.Specifically, electrode column 70 is connected by conductive pole 72 with the riveting of conductive pressing plate 40, during riveting, conductive pole 72 expansions, extrude the inwall of fixing hole 43 so that conductive pole 72 is fixed with conductive pressing plate 40, and conductive pressing plate 40 also plays support simultaneously Electrode column 70, the effect for not allowing electrode column 70 to drop.

Fig. 2 to Fig. 7 is referred to, further, the insulated support 60 is annular in shape and is sheathed on the conductive pole 72 On.Insulated support 60 is set on conductive pole 72, and it can not be moved freely in the horizontal direction, can prevent insulating supporting Part 60 departs from the position between conductive pressing plate 40 and metal cover board 30 and can not effectively isolate and lead after the thawing of insulation spacer 50 Voltage plate 40 and metal cover board 30.

Fig. 1 to Fig. 7 is referred to, further, the upper surface of the metal cover board 30, which is provided with, supplies the insulated support 60 The lower mounting groove 32 of lower end insertion, the lower surface of the conductive pressing plate 40 are provided with for the upper of the upper end of insulated support 60 insertion Mounting groove 44.Insulated support 60 is installed with the space that upper mounting groove 44 and lower mounting groove 32 are formed by the utility model embodiment It is interior so that the battery appearance after assembling is compacter, attractive in appearance.

Fig. 1 to Fig. 7 is referred to, further, the insulation spacer 50 is provided with spacing hole 51, on the metal cover board 30 Provided with the spacing preiection 33 for inserting the spacing hole 51.In assembling, first insulation spacer 50 can be sticked on metal cover board 30 So that spacing preiection 33 inserts spacing hole 51, the opposing metallic cover plate 30 of insulation spacer 50 remains stationary as, convenient to install next part. It is to be appreciated that the raised height of spacing preiection 33 should be unlikely to contact with conductive pressing plate 40, to prevent that large area is short-circuit. Preferably, the conductive pressing plate 40 is provided with escape groove 46 towards the side of the metal cover board 30, and the insertion of spacing preiection 33 avoids In groove 46 so that spacing preiection 33 will not contact with conductive pressing plate 40.

Fig. 1 to Fig. 7 is referred to, further, the conductive pressing plate 40 is provided with boss 45 towards the side of insulation spacer 50, The insulation spacer 50 is provided with the storage tank 52 for the boss 45 insertion towards the side of the conductive pressing plate 40.Specifically, Conductive pressing plate 40 is installed with enables to battery appearance compact in storage tank 52, attractive in appearance, in addition, conductive pressing plate 40 is wrapped in It after in storage tank 52, also can further avoid the edge of conductive pressing plate 40 from being contacted with metal cover board 30, short circuit occurs.

Fig. 8 is referred to, further, explosion-proof through hole 34 is provided with the metal cover board 30, the metal cover board 30 is also Including sealing the burst disk 35 located at the explosion-proof through hole 34 close to the side of storage case 20.The big volume production of short circuit is occurring for battery core 10 When hot, inside battery meeting expanded by heating, in order to avoid exploding, the utility model embodiment on metal cover board 30 by setting Explosion-proof through hole 34 is put, burst disk 35, when inside battery expanded by heating, the meeting of burst disk 35 then are set in the explosion-proof bottom of through hole 34 Rupture so that cell internal pressure reduces, so as to avoid battery explosion.

Fig. 8 is referred to, further, to avoid burst disk 35 in routine use, by external damage, causes battery electric Liquid leakage is solved, the lithium ion battery includes envelope and is located at explosive-proof protector of the explosion-proof through hole 34 away from the side of storage case 20 Film 36.The explosive-proof protector film 36 can protect burst disk 35 not by external damage.
